solution.title: Google Workspace ↔ Intune Third-Party EMM Integration for Managed Google Play

products.name: Google Workspace ↔ Intune Third-Party EMM Integration for Managed Google Play — Commercial
products.short_description: Integrate Google Workspace / Cloud Identity with Intune as third-party EMM for managed Google Play — the Google Admin console + Intune configuration, the identity model, and a clear read on re-enrollment / end-user impact — so you enable it confidently. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Integrate Google Workspace with Intune as third-party EMM — without surprise re-enrollments

If your users have Google Workspace / Cloud Identity accounts, connecting managed Google Play to Intune is a different integration than the standard account-enterprise bind — and teams rightly worry it will re-enroll existing devices. This solution walks the Google Workspace ↔ Intune third-party EMM integration end to end: the Google Admin console side (enable a third-party Android EMM provider), the Intune side, the identity/account model, and a clear read on enrollment/re-enrollment impact and end-user experience — so you enable it confidently.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the Google Workspace ↔ Intune third-party EMM model (vs the account-enterprise bind), how managed Google Play is delegated, and the identity/account implications.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (Google Workspace/Cloud Identity super-admin, Intune admin, the binding-model decision, endpoints).
  • Implementation Guide — configure the Google Admin console third-party EMM integration, complete the Intune side, validate account add + app delivery, and assess re-enrollment / end-user impact before broad rollout — pilot-first; re-enrollment behavior verified against current Microsoft/Google guidance, not assumed.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic Microsoft Graph / Intune automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
  • Validation gates (integration active, accounts add, existing devices behave as expected) plus Best Practices; enrollment-impact claims flagged to verify in your tenant.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Managed Google Play delegated to Intune for your Google Workspace org — integration active, accounts adding, and the re-enrollment question answered before you flip the switch — enabled with confidence.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • ANDROIDGW-DeviceImpact.ps1 — read-only existing-Android-device impact / enrollment-state report for the re-enrollment assessment
    • ANDROIDGW-Discovery.ps1 — read-only current managed Google Play binding + Workspace-integration posture assessment via Microsoft Graph
    • ANDROIDGW-Readiness.ps1 — read-only integration-readiness + identity checker for the Google Workspace <-> Intune third-party EMM integration
    • ANDROIDGW-Set-Scope.ps1 — scope/config helper that creates & populates the pilot group for the integration. Defaults to -WhatIf (NO changes)
    • ANDROIDGW-Validation.ps1 — read-only account-add + app-delivery validation report for the Workspace <-> Intune third-party EMM integration

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
